# GymBro Flutter - GitHub Repository Setup

## Repository Information

- **URL**: https://github.com/MicheleFerr/gymbro-flutter
- **Visibility**: Private
- **Framework**: Flutter
- **Architecture**: Clean Architecture + Riverpod
- **Database**: Firebase Firestore
- **Setup Date**: 2025-11-10

## Quick Start

### Clone
```bash
git clone https://github.com/MicheleFerr/gymbro-flutter.git
cd gymbro-flutter
```

### Install Dependencies
```bash
flutter pub get
```

### Run
```bash
flutter run
```

### Test
```bash
flutter test
```
